candidate.purpose: Official market-data SDK pattern review for streaming, live trades, depth, retries and entitlement-aware data access.
candidate.docsAndTests: README documents streaming, retries, plan behavior and security; repository includes tests, examples and CI configuration.
candidate.dataCostRequirements: Pro+/entitlement-gated for WebSocket/live trades/depth; designed for Tadawul rather than U.S. equities.
candidate.securityNotes: API-key via environment recommended; transient 429/5xx retry policy documented. Do not transplant credentials or proprietary endpoints.
candidate.latencyNotes: Streaming surfaces are appropriate as a design reference, but no U.S. equity latency/coverage benefit for TAGX can be inferred.
candidate.lookAheadBiasRisk: LOW_FROM_SDK_PATTERN_ITSELF; any replay use still requires point-in-time event timestamps and no retroactive enrichment.
candidate.rationale: Strong, recent operational patterns for retries, streaming, entitlements and live-trade surfaces, but underlying data scope is Saudi/Tadawul and therefore does not solve TAGX U.S. market coverage. Borrow reliability patterns only; no production dependency.
